newsitem.title: USA: Manhattan Bagel CFO-designate can't serve.
newsitem.headline: Manhattan Bagel CFO-designate can't serve.

text.p: Manhattan Bagel Co Inc said on Tuesday Richard Falcone, who had been appointed the company's chief financial officer, would not be able to start the job because of events at his former employer.

Falcone had been chief operating officer of book retailer and distributor National Merchants Management Corp. He told Manhattan Bagel that events associated with the unexpected death of the founder of National Merchants would prevent him from assuming the postition at the beginning of this month.
Manhattan Bagel said it had resumed a search for new candidates for the CFO position. In the meantime, Chairman Jack Grumet would assume the position, the company said.
National Merchants' founder died in late December, and its chief executive officer died last summer, the company said.

"In the wake of these unanticipated and tragic developments, Mr. Falcone, who maintains an equity position in National Merchants, told us that he would have devote a good deal of time to the sale of that company," Grumet said.
